headline: Wardens Surge in Weathered Expanse; Colonials Widen Nevish Line Lead
war_summary: Since our last edition the scales have tilted both ways. The Weathered Expanse, still the war's busiest ground with fifty-eight flag events in a day, has swung Warden: five stands now fly their colour against one, three lie in rubble, and Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Shattered Advance saw the heaviest exchanges. On the Nevish Line the Colonials have answered in kind, widening their grip to six posts against two, the once-ruined ground since rebuilt; its day's toll above twenty-four thousand remains the war's heaviest, with Mistle Shrine and Grief Mother among the busiest stations. Linn Mercy bleeds hardest of all — upward of nineteen thousand casualties in a day and more than fourteen hundred a side in the last hour — Lathair and Outwich Ranch its storm-centres, its ledger seven stands to two. Mooring County's tempest at The Wind Hills has faded to a trickle, Stonecradle and the Dead Lands have gone quiet, and Callahans Passage still collects a heavy toll without a flag moving. It is day 754; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
